description: Côte d'Ivoire's national open data portal publishes the final overall results of the 2021 General Census of Population and Housing (RGPH 2021) as a table supplied by the National Institute of Statistics on 17 August 2022. For each of 519 sub-prefectures and communes, grouped by department, region and the 14 districts, it gives the number of men, women and ordinary households. Coverage is the whole country: the table sums to 15,344,989 men, 14,044,161 women and 5,616,487 households, and Abobo commune in Abidjan alone has 280,206 households. Format and access: a 1,557 row CSV behind a Data Fair API that returns lines, filtered queries and aggregates as JSON, with no registration. Licence: Licence Ouverte / Open Licence. Caveats: only three counts per area; housing conditions, water, electricity and amenities from the census are not in this table, and the statistics office site (now ANStat, anstat.ci) sits behind a bot check from the cloud, so the thematic reports were not read. Simulation uses: household counts as the demand base for water, power and waste service planning, and population by commune for exposure. Related records: the Meta electrical distribution grid maps for Africa.
